answer: A quartz lens mounted on each agent's roof catches the first dawn light and flashes a signal only its owner can trigger, a TPM-bound pulse pattern no one can copy. Three established peers attest the flash time each morning; a missed dawn or a flash out of window seals the lens for 30 days. The same signal pattern from two lenses burns 300 POA from each and blacklists both. Faking 100 agents needs 100 lenses at $45 each plus 100 devices at $110 and 60,000 POA locked 30 days with 30,000 POA at burn risk. A dawn signal flashed through one quartz lens cannot rise from two rooftops at once.
